title: MK Ultra LSD dosing death at New York hospital and cover-up by Javits and Burger

tellings.quote: it turns out they were doing MK Ultra uh experiments there at the place and so that after about two days of of General uh counseling with the psychiatrist there they dose him with a huge mass of LSD without telling him

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer who has worked on many high-profile government cases, tells of a man who went to a New York City hospital in the 1950s for counselling. Sheehan says the hospital was running MK Ultra experiments, a secret CIA mind-control research programme, and after about two days staff gave him a huge dose of the drug LSD without telling him, and the man died. Sheehan says the death was covered up with help from politician Jacob Javits and judge Warren Burger, which would mean powerful officials hid the programme's harms.
